messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — payment-service v2 deploy scheduled 2026-03-18 02:00 UTC. Need final rollback owners and the smoke-check checklist. Share your short confirmations and any last-minute blockers. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/payment-service-deploy

devin: I can own rollback. If we need to revert, I'll coordinate and run the rollback steps.

samir: QA will do smoke. My plan: +5m basic auth/login flows, +10m checkout, +15m invoice gen, +20m websocket health. Will post pass/fail markers.

jen (oncall): I'll watch metrics and alerts. Key monitors: 99p latency, error-rate >0.5%, queue depth >200. If any trigger, @devin gets pinged and we start rollback.

maria: Thanks. Can we confirm the specific rollback command and the snapshot tag to roll back to? Also confirm DB migration concerns (there are none, right?).

devin: Rollback command (k8s):
```
kubectl -n payments set image deploy/payment-service payment-service=payment-service:2026-03-17-21
kubectl rollout status deploy/payment-service -n payments
```
Fallback tag: payment-service:2026-03-17-21 (pre-deploy). No DB migrations in this release — safe to rollback without migration reversal.

samir: Noted. QA checklist (short):
- login (ok)
- create cart + checkout (ok)
- invoice PDF generation (ok)
- websocket connect & realtime events (ok)
- downstream webhook deliverability (smoke)
I'll post results as emojis: :white_check_mark: or :x:.

maria: Ownership matrix:
- rollback owner: @devin
- smoke lead: @samir
- metrics/oncall: @jen (oncall)
- deploy trigger: @maria
All good?

jen (oncall): Good with me. I'll keep slack notifications unmuted and pager on.

devin: I'm on call for rollback steps and will be available in the window +30m.

samir: Will start smoke at +5m and update here.

ops-bot: deploy-plan created: payment-service v2 -> staging -> canary -> prod. Canary window: 10 minutes.

maria: Canary policies — if any of the following occur during canary, abort and rollback:
- 5xx rate > 0.3% for 2 consecutive 1m buckets
- error-rate spike > 2x baseline sustained for 3m
- P99 latency increases > 200ms absolute
If triggered, @devin implement rollback and @jen start mitigation.

samir: Starting smoke now (+5m)

samir: login: :white_check_mark:

samir: checkout: :white_check_mark:

samir: invoice gen: :white_check_mark:

samir: websocket: :white_check_mark:

samir: webhooks: :white_check_mark:

maria: All smoke items green. Ops, you still monitoring metrics?

jen (oncall): Metrics look stable so far. 5xx = 0.02%, p99 +40ms from baseline but under threshold. No alerts.

ops-bot: canary progressed to 10% traffic at 1769987900

maria: OK — proceeding to full rollout in 10m if no regressions. Final go/no-go: please respond with one-word confirmations.

devin: go

samir: go

jen (oncall): go

maria: go — starting final rollout. If anyone sees unexpected behavior, call rollback immediately.

ops-bot: rollout completed to 100% at 1769988100

samir: Post-deploy quick check: login/checkouts/invoice/workers all green.

jen (oncall): No alerts in the last 10m. All clear from oncall.

devin: I'll keep an eye for 30m then clear myself as rollback owner.

maria: Thanks team — closing thread after 30m of stability. If anything comes up, reopen. :tada:
